thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Detected elevated 5xxs and tail latency for tenant `skyline` (VPC: eu-west-2) on pool skyline-ded-01. Auto-fallback attempted to `skyline-safe-v1` but observed worker evictions.

Sam: I'm awake. Opening bridge and paging infra/runtime. @Marco please pull dmesg + runtime logs.

Marco: joining. Quick look: repeated OOM kills in model workers. GPU mem usage near 100% when seq_len > 2048. KV-cache growth correlated.

Leah: we shipped a kv-cache retention tweak in runtime yesterday that increases in-memory retention. Could be triggering. Recommend immediate pin to stable `skyline-v2.8` OR force-route Skyline to `dedicated-evac-1` standby pool.

Jorge: note on fidelity: `skyline-safe-v1` is quantized q4f and trims cache windows; slightly shorter outputs but safe for critical flows. We'll advise customer CSE.

Maya: drafting customer note now. Short: temporary model pin and routing to standby pool to reduce latency; will follow up with postmortem.

Nina: spinning two burst GPUs in eu-west-2 to add capacity. ETA ~9m.

Sam: Plan: 1) Pause/redirect traffic away from skyline-ded-01 2) Pin tenant to last-known-stable 3) Prefer evac pool or safe variant 4) Monitor for regressions

Marco: executing pin and initial drain. Pasting command:
```
redwood tenant update --tenant skyline --model skyline-v2.8 --pin true --reason "auto-rollback: OOMs on skyline-ded-01"
```

Marco: pin applied, id=pin-a1b2c3. Starting session drain.

Leah: creating routing override in Console -> Tenants -> skyline -> Routing -> Add override -> prefer dedicated-evac-1.

incident-bot: Route override applied by Leah. Sessions being migrated.

Nina: burst nodes online and warming. Eviction rate falling.

Sam: handing infra ops to @Nina. I'll stay on comms and incident lead.

Marco: logs archived to s3://redwood-incidents/skyline/1760123456/ (includes dmesg, runtime logs, eviction traces).

Jorge: running quick diff on canonical prompts between v2.8 and v3: only minor phrasing changes, critical outputs preserved.

Maya: emailed Skyline: "We've applied a temporary pin and routed to a warm standby pool to mitigate latency. We'll update within 30m and follow up with a postmortem." They replied: "Thanks for the heads-up."

Leah: mitigation check: error rate down 8% -> 0.7% over 10m, median latency down to ~600ms.

Sam: good. Capture the full timeline for the runbook and postmortem. Who wants ownership?

Marco: I'll own the postmortem. Kickoff and initial notes in /pm/incident-playbooks/1760123456-skyline-kvcache.md. Draft due in 48h.

Leah: follow-ups: 1) revert or make kv-cache retention adaptive 2) add adaptive cap based on observed seq_len distribution 3) add tenant-level automatic pin trigger on OOM signature

Jorge: also: add `skyline-safe-v1` to model catalog standby list and run fidelity regression for top 50 intents.

Nina: unpin criteria: 24h stable metrics on skyline-ded-01 + 30m 5% canary. Unpin command to run when ready: 
```
redwood tenant update --tenant skyline --pin false --reason "postmitigation unpin"
```

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation in place. Summary: pin v2.8 + routing to evac pool + burst nodes. Error rate normalized.

Sam: shifting to monitoring mode. Keep this thread open for 1h for any regression alerts. If anything spikes, @oncall paged.

Maya: will prepare customer-facing summary once postmortem draft ready.

Nina: retaining infra watch. Will coordinate unpin when safe.

Sam: Bridge closed. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
